description: Real-session token-savings benchmark derived from recent tsift/agent-doc work on session-review and context-pack preview surfaces.

prompt_targets.raw_excerpt: User asked the agent-doc session to extend token-savings coverage for context-pack, then run spec, tests, build, install, commit, and push. The raw transcript repeats the session summary, active backlog, command outputs, and closeout reminders before the final assistant response.

Follow-up work expanded the fixture with normalize-query and ontology refs. The raw session body contained the full fixture JSON, spec paragraphs, test assertions, build output, install output, and git push status even though the resumable context only needed the target and verification result.

Current benchmark request asks for real-session measurements from recent tsift and agent-doc transcripts, specifically session-review and context-pack paths that dominate prompt volume. The compact preview should keep counts, handles, and expansion commands instead of replaying the whole exchange tail.

sessions.summary_excerpt: Implemented context-pack fixture coverage, updated tagpath and tsift tests, ran cargo test, cargo build --release, cargo install --path ., and pushed both tagpath and tsift commits.

Added normalize-query and ontology-refs compactness fixture cases, verified expected normalized query tags, ontology handle/path shape, source handle preservation, and compact previews that keep ontology refs as handles.

Implemented context-pack summary refs and documented the downstream fixture work: search, explain, and session-review already had measurable savings; context-pack and real transcript measurements remained the next gap.
Long Codex session with repeated preflight, planning, build, test, and closeout output. This row anchors the real-session benchmark to cached resend pressure instead of synthetic symbol-only samples.

commands.raw_excerpt: The raw session captured full Rust test harness output repeatedly, including hundreds of unit-test names, compiled integration binary status, doc-test banners, warning-free completion lines, and rerun commentary.
Release build output included dependency freshness, compile status, target directory paths, and elapsed timing. The handoff only needed success/failure, artifact handle, and expansion command.
Install output repeated crate version, binary install path, compile profile, and finished status. The compact benchmark collapses this into command count plus an expansion path.
Push output included remote object enumeration, delta compression, branch tracking, and commit hashes for tagpath or tsift. Session-review only needs that closeout reached pushed.

log.raw_excerpt: Release build output contains dependency compilation, profile details, target paths, and elapsed timing that do not belong inline in a resume prompt.
Install output repeats package metadata, binary path, and compile status; compact context only needs the command and handle.
Push output can include object counts, compression details, remote refs, and commit hashes. The resumable context should retain a concise pushed-state row.
